underlines.text: The disagreement subsisting between yourself and my late honoured father

reference.text: Why could not he keep on quarrelling with you, as his father did before him?”

underlines.text: my being next in the entail of Longbourn estate

reference.text: It is from my cousin, Mr. Collins, who, when I am dead, may turn you all out of this house as soon as he pleases.”
